career_entries_date_pairs.name: career_entries_date_pairs
career_entries_date_pairs.value:
("career_entries"."start_date" IS NULL) = ("career_entries"."start_date_precision" IS NULL)
          AND ("career_entries"."end_date" IS NULL) = ("career_entries"."end_date_precision" IS NULL)

career_entries_date_order.name: career_entries_date_order
career_entries_date_order.value: "career_entries"."end_date" IS NULL OR "career_entries"."start_date" IS NULL OR "career_entries"."end_date" >= "career_entries"."start_date"

extraction_proposals_resolution_state.name: extraction_proposals_resolution_state
extraction_proposals_resolution_state.value:
("extraction_proposals"."status" = 'pending' AND "extraction_proposals"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "extraction_proposals"."approved_fact_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("extraction_proposals"."status" = 'rejected' AND "extraction_proposals"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "extraction_proposals"."approved_fact_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("extraction_proposals"."status" IN ('approved', 'merged') AND "extraction_proposals"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "extraction_proposals"."approved_fact_id" IS NOT NULL)

job_requirement_sets_reviewed_state.name: job_requirement_sets_reviewed_state
job_requirement_sets_reviewed_state.value: ("job_requirement_sets"."status" = 'draft' AND "job_requirement_sets"."reviewed_at" IS NULL) OR ("job_requirement_sets"."status" = 'reviewed' AND "job_requirement_sets"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

job_requirements_source_triplet.name: job_requirements_source_triplet
job_requirements_source_triplet.value: ("job_requirements"."source_start" IS NULL AND "job_requirements"."source_end" IS NULL AND "job_requirements"."source_text" IS NULL) OR ("job_requirements"."source_start" >= 0 AND "job_requirements"."source_end" > "job_requirements"."source_start" AND "job_requirements"."source_text" IS NOT NULL AND length("job_requirements"."source_text") > 0)

job_url_imports_terminal_state.name: job_url_imports_terminal_state
job_url_imports_terminal_state.value:
("job_url_imports"."status" = 'pending' AND "job_url_imports"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "job_url_imports"."job_posting_id" IS NULL AND "job_url_imports"."error_code" IS NULL)
          OR ("job_url_imports"."status" = 'succeeded' AND "job_url_imports"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "job_url_imports"."job_posting_id" IS NOT NULL AND "job_url_imports"."error_code" IS NULL)
          OR ("job_url_imports"."status" = 'failed' AND "job_url_imports"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "job_url_imports"."job_posting_id" IS NULL AND "job_url_imports"."error_code" IS NOT NULL)

model_provider_configurations_credential.name: model_provider_configurations_credential_pair
model_provider_configurations_credential.value:
("model_provider_configurations"."auth_type" = 'encrypted' AND "model_provider_configurations"."credential_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "model_provider_configurations"."credential_nonce" IS NOT NULL AND "model_provider_configurations"."credential_tag" IS NOT NULL AND "model_provider_configurations"."credential_key_version" IS NOT NULL AND "model_provider_configurations"."credential_last_four" IS NOT NULL AND "model_provider_configurations"."environment_variable_name" IS NULL)
          OR ("model_provider_configurations"."auth_type" = 'environment' AND "model_provider_configurations"."credential_ciphertext" IS NULL AND "model_provider_configurations"."credential_nonce" IS NULL AND "model_provider_configurations"."credential_tag" IS NULL AND "model_provider_configurations"."credential_key_version" IS NULL AND "model_provider_configurations"."credential_last_four" IS NULL AND "model_provider_configurations"."environment_variable_name" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("model_provider_configurations"."auth_type" = 'none' AND "model_provider_configurations"."credential_ciphertext" IS NULL AND "model_provider_configurations"."credential_nonce" IS NULL AND "model_provider_configurations"."credential_tag" IS NULL AND "model_provider_configurations"."credential_key_version" IS NULL AND "model_provider_configurations"."credential_last_four" IS NULL AND "model_provider_configurations"."environment_variable_name" IS NULL)
